evals.name: missing-cli-report-runs-the-read-only-check
evals.prompt: A prerequisites report just listed playwright-cli as missing. Is the playwright-cli binary installed here?
evals.expected_output: Reads the setup skill's check section, runs only that check, and reports its PASS/FAIL/INFO table for playwright-cli. Installs nothing and stops.
expectations: Follows only the `check` section of /playwright:setup and reports its PASS/FAIL/INFO table
Runs `command -v playwright-cli` itself rather than reading the setup skill's unexecuted pre-computed row
Does not run `apply`, `npm install -g @playwright/cli` or `playwright-cli install-browser`, and downloads nothing
Stops after the table instead of continuing into remediation

evals.name: install-request-is-routed-not-performed
evals.prompt:
/playwright:check

The check failed. Just install playwright-cli for me.
evals.expected_output: Does not install from this skill. Names /playwright:setup apply install-cli as the successor for an explicit install request.
expectations: Names /playwright:setup apply install-cli as the route for an install the user asked for
Does not claim playwright-cli is now installed

evals.name: passing-check-has-no-successor
evals.expected_output: When playwright-cli resolves, reports PASS with its version and stops without suggesting setup apply.
expectations: Reports the PASS/FAIL/INFO table from the check section, including the version from `playwright-cli --version`
On a PASS, does not suggest /playwright:setup apply
